findings.message:
Reentrancy in BANK_SAFE.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0x561eac93c92360949ab1f1403323e6db345cbf31.sol#47-60):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (../sb/0x561eac93c92360949ab1f1403323e6db345cbf31.sol#54)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _am (../sb/0x561eac93c92360949ab1f1403323e6db345cbf31.sol#56)
	BANK_SAFE.balances (../sb/0x561eac93c92360949ab1f1403323e6db345cbf31.sol#11) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- BANK_SAFE.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0x561eac93c92360949ab1f1403323e6db345cbf31.sol#47-60)
	- BANK_SAFE.Deposit() (../sb/0x561eac93c92360949ab1f1403323e6db345cbf31.sol#39-45)
	- BANK_SAFE.balances (../sb/0x561eac93c92360949ab1f1403323e6db345cbf31.sol#11)
findings.name: reentrancy-eth
